concepts.gloss_en: The rock (tzur) as a mystical bechinah — associated with the heart ('צור לבבי') and the rock that gushed water ('פתח צור ויזובו מים')

members.note: representative; in lm1:20 = rock as bechinah of lev, tied to Ps. 105 and 'צור לבבי'

concepts.gloss_en: 'The Rock' — appears in lm2:15 in a context of the true tzaddik / baalei tzedakah, distinct referent (likely a divine epithet, 'the Rock' = God) rather than the rock-as-heart bechinah of lm1:20

members.note: definite form in a different Torah (lm2:15) and different context — tzaddik/tzedakah, not the lev/water rock of lm1:20

notes: Kept separate per under-merge and definite-article rules. Different Torahs and unrelated contexts: lm1:20 צור = rock as bechinah of the heart (water-from-rock); lm2:15 הצור sits in a tzaddik/tzedakah passage and its cited proof does not even show 'הצור' in the quoted text, so its referent is uncertain (plausibly the divine epithet 'the Rock'). Do not merge without human review.
